title: How can I build a 3D fighter-jet game using AI for free, with only an Android tablet?
author: Fearless_Search_9182
selftext:
Hi everyone new to sub !
I'm interested in making a retro 3D air-combat game inspired by AIR COMBAT LEGENDS(search steam it has not come out yet) and older Cold War flight simulators and DCS world (on steam). 




My current situation:
Device: Samsung Galaxy Tab S9 FE+ (Android tablet).
No gaming PC or laptop available right now.
Budget: 0. I want to use free tools and free AI models/API credits wherever possible.
Coding experience: Beginner. I'd prefer AI to write most of the code and help debug it.though i know basic web dev 
I can use a browser and online coding platforms.






What I want to build:
A playable 3D fighter-jet game with a chase camera.
Low-poly aircraft, ocean, islands, mountains, clouds and airbases.
Touchscreen flight controls that work on Android.
Flight physics, HUD, enemy jets, guns, missiles and missions eventually.
A browser-playable version first, followed by a more advanced PC game that I could eventually publish on Steam.


My questions:
What is the best completely free workflow for my situation?
Which AI tools can generate and improve the actual game, rather than just produce a demo or a picture?
Can I do the development, testing and file management entirely on my tablet?
Are there any genuinely useful free AI coding agents or free API models that can handle repeated debugging?
Should I use Three.js, Godot, Unreal Engine through a cloud PC, or something else?
Is there any way to automate most of the process with an AI agent without paying for subscriptions?
I'm not expecting a professional DCS-level simulator immediately. I'm happy to start small and build it step by step, but I want a realistic path towards the bigger project.
I'd especially appreciate advice from people who have actually built 3D games using AI on limited hardware or free tools.




Thanks!
